scope: Release-source APK built and installed with an ephemeral CI-only signing key on an isolated Android 15 emulator. No user credentials, private release key or real vehicle used.
instrumentation_scope: Background/return retains WebView and form state
Actual Android Keystore encryption and nonexportable key
Account restoration after Activity recreation without auto login
Ciphertext corruption rejection and account/key deletion
screenshot_limit: Android FLAG_SECURE produces a black app screenshot. Visual layout checks use separate actual Chromium fixture screenshots; the emulator screenshot is not visual app verification.
